scope: complete SPH V1 denominator, with ranking only on a known-statement subset; development, not independent or clinical validation

reference.positive: target statement present without Normal ECG
reference.explicit_control: Normal ECG is the only primary statement
reference.ambiguous: Normal ECG and any other primary statement, not a valid control
reference.unknown: all other records; never convert to negative

other_support_screen.interpretation: lower-bound support of mapped out-of-profile statements; not a complete Other target, not a classifier and excludes Normal ECG

scoring: threshold-free AUROC and average precision only; no frozen auxiliary thresholds, no confusion matrix or clinical operating point
